name: Yukon
short: Yukon's Affordable Heat Pump Program covers 100% of a heat pump project up to $24,000 for households under an income line, and everyone else can get 50% up to $10,500. Insulation pays up to $12,000 for walls, windows $120 each, and the Dependable Grid Program pays 50% up to $15,000 for non-electric heating. You need approval before installing a heat pump under the income-based program.

rows.rules: After-tax income under $53,820 for 1 person, $163,300 for 4. Approval before installing.
